vignette: A newborn is found to have a tooth present in the mouth at birth. The clinician is deciding how to manage it.
stem: Which consideration is most appropriate when managing this natal tooth?

options.text: Consider any medical or contributing factors
Base the decision on the tooth alone, since medical history has no bearing on management
Remove the tooth routinely in every case, regardless of the infant's medical circumstances
Make the decision without considering contributing factors, relying on tooth mobility alone
